people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: The Philistine said to David, “Come to me, and I will give your flesh to the birds of the sky, and to the animals of the field.”
translations.bsb: “Come here,” he called to David, “and I will give your flesh to the birds of the air and the beasts of the field!”
translations.kjv: And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give thy flesh unto the fowls of the air, and to the beasts of the field.
translations.asv: And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give thy flesh unto the birds of the heavens, and to the beasts of the field.
